test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Navratna company is fondly called 'Vizag steel'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited**__.

__
 
• **Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited Company is called Vizag Steel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited,** the corporate arm of Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, is a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Steel.

 
 
• It was established in 1982, RINL was wholly owned by the Government of India. In November 2010, the company was accorded Navratna status by the government.
 
• It is the first coast-based integrated steel plant in the country.
 
• It is the first steel plant to be certified to ISO 9001:2008 (currently 2015), ISO 14001:2004 (currently 2015), OHSAS 18001:2007 and ISO/IEC 27001:2013 standards.
 
• It is also the first PSU to be certified ISO 50001:2011 Energy Management System and has received CMMI Level 3 certification for development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 **IISCO Steel Plant**
 
 
 
• IISCO steel plant was founded in 1918.
 
• IISCO Steel Plant of Steel Authority of India Limited is an integrated steel plant located at Burnpur, West Bengal, India.
 
 
 
 

 **Rourkela Steel Plant**
 
 
 
• Rourkela Steel Plant, in Rourkela, Odisha is the first integrated steel plant in the public sector in India.
 
• It was set up with West Germany collaboration with an installed capacity of 1 million tonnes in the 1960s.
 
• It is operated by the Steel Authority of India.
 
 
 
 

 **Bokaro Steel Plant**
 
 
 
• It was founded on 29 January 1964.
 
• It is the fourth integrated public sector steel plant in India built with Soviet help.
